lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One month since the burnt espresso. Same café, same weird hours.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They're at the counter holding two cups. One of them is yours.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: A month of putting up with dispatch schedules. I counted.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One month since the burnt espresso. They're at the counter, two cups.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You could buy out this whole café now. You liked it better when you couldn't.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: A month of putting up with dispatch schedules. I counted.

choices.label: Felt like a year. Good year.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Somebody has to keep records around here. You're always on shift.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They slide your cup over. Your exact order. They never asked; they learned.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: So. Best moment of the month. Go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They laugh into their coffee. The window light does its thing.
